notes.title: SUPER ANNIVERSARY UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey there, Omar here.

It's usually Matt writing these Steam announcements, and he's done a bang-up job on all of them. So please give a virtual and probably metaphorical round of applause to the venerable Matt Cundy. 

[i]Woo! We love you, Matt![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/6db88d5b971ce7b47539cc1696d92c8622988421.gif[/img]

But I figured this update ought to come directly from me.
If you don't know, my name is Omar Samir, I'm the lead developer of Super Buff HD, and I grinded my [i]dick and balls[/i] off to get this game out the door. I don't know if I can say that in an update post. Steam might just automatically censor it. Matt'll know. I don't.

ANYWAY, this post should be going up on the 29th of September, celebrating both the release of a new update, and the [b]1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY OF THE RELEASE OF SUPER BUFF HD.[/b] Easily one of the craziest times in my life, with some of the hardest and longest hours I've ever worked, regularly working multiple days at a time with only the shortest interruptions to eat or use the bathroom.

And it all lead to that magic moment... The day of release. Clicking that button and showing the world my baby, the game I'd put so much of myself and so much of my soul into.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/a939457e771f0baf7aec9b4bfbf0bed6d3ac0d50.gif[/img]

I'm gonna cut the crap... It bombed like Hell. It bombed harder than if Diddy and Drake teamed up and decided THIS was the time to launch their career as a stand-up comedy duo. I've been contacted by the UN, informing me that the next global conflict will have to be titled World War 4, because Super Buff HD bombed so hard, not even real bombs could out-bomb it.

And you know what? I'd do it again, in a heartbeat. Honestly? It was fun. It was DAMN fun, no matter how hard it was. It was good. It was enriching to my soul, in a way that no other work had ever felt. And the critical reception has been [i]phenomenal.[/i] Doesn't matter how hard it bombed financially, the people who liked Buff [i]really[/i] liked Buff. People were championing Buff like it was their friend and they were trying to set it up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/c559cd10e6041feebc90e5a8e44be763e0b6ae16.gif[/img]

Every once in a while, I randomly run into someone who's played the game, and they always have the nicest, most heartfelt things to say about it. Every now and then, I'll look up the game on Twitter or just Google and see people who really had a nice little time with it. And that lights up the whole week for me.

And on that note; I have to thank Super Buff HD's small but passionate speedrunning community. These runs have absolutely blown me away, and I highly recommend checking them out:
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TrenchNinja21]TrenchNinja21[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/@c00lkidsix9]c00LKID69[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bystandertim_]BystanderTim_[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/zzrules21]zzrules21[/url]
[/list]
Watching their runs has been so fulfilling and so damn fun. I've always loved speedruns, and Buff was definitely made with runners in mind, so watching runs of my game is a high I'll never get enough of. It's also AMAZING to me that 2 of the 4 top runners for the game have "21" in their usernames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/87572695776dd1a8674eb7b1111f8b77856cf86c.png[/img]

I could honestly talk about the game and everything related to it for a thousand hours and never repeat myself, but this is Steam, and you've got games to play. So I'll cut it short. WHAT'S NEW in the anniversary update?

Well... Not a lot, actually. But let's cover what's been added...

[list]
[*] [b]"Ingame Timer"[/b] option has been renamed to [b]"Buff Stats"[/b], as it now displays the [b]ingame level timer, your current movement speed, and adds a laser sight to the Assault Roll and Spudder weapons[/b] for more precise aiming at high speeds.
[*] Added in-level graffiti featuring (poorly drawn) references to [b]Minmo the cat[/b] from [i]Silent Hill 3[/i], [b]Solid Snake in a cardboard box from the Tanker chapter[/b] from [i]Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty[/i], the [b]Venture Industries logo before it got dissolved into Ventech in season 6[/b] from [i]the Venture Bros.[/i], the [b]"NO LOAFING!" sign from Strong Bad's room[/b] from [i]Homestarrunner[/i], [b]Tofu from the Tofu Survivor mode[/b] from [i]Resident Evil 2[/i] and [i]Resident Evil 2 Remake[/i], and a [b]few more[/b] that I can't remember off the top of my [i]head[/i] right now.
[*] And that's it. Told you it wasn't a lot.
[/list]

If nothing else, I hope this makes someone laugh. I sure did.

Thank you all for this past year, and the years leading up to it. You're all buff in my eyes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/f07eec7fb56274527173227a5eb4f06e47c5889a.jpg[/img]


P.S. Matt could you populate this post with some pictures or gifs or whatever so it's not just a bland wall of text? I see an image on the right that says "Player Endorsements" that I haven't seen before in any of the previous posts. Let's see them endorsements, babyyy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/0be2ac91a86fc49b67b7bfdcc6ad17280345dbcc.png[/img]

P.P.S. Obviously leave the P.S. and P.P.S. in the final Steam post. Funnier that way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/ade1dfcd85fe430eefc8b44566def36bd895db10.png[/img]

notes.title: Season Selector, speedrun options, QoL changes, fixes
notes.content:
[i][h3][b]OLA BUFFSTERS! We done snuck out a small but meaningful update. The big news is you can now switch between seasons in the Options menu, so you can play with the Halloween, Christmas, or Valentines cosmetic makeovers splashed all over the game whenever you damn well want. Other update goodness listed below![/b][/h3][/i]  

[h3][b]PATCH NOTES:
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Season Selector to pick which season you're playing it. It's Christmas in August.
[*] A speedometer below the level timer, for speed purposes.
[*] New UI elements to display your "Stack," which include your jumps, your dash, and your extra surf-jump.
[*] Speedrun buttons in the Tutorial select submenu, to "purge" and "regain" your nukes and extra weapons.
[*] A fix for the unattainable nuke in Dinner 'n' a Show.
[*] Sharks now take 1.5x damage from surfing or grinding. This only applies to the sharks. Lol. Lmao.
[*] Resolution Scale option to help performance.
[*] Fix for the jittery FOV and screen effects that only occur when you grind on a rail for less than .25 seconds, the screen and FOV effects should interpolate smoothly now no matter what.
[*] Changed Tim Sweeney's special thanks in the credits from Timmy Sweens to Tim Epic, for performance optimization purposes.
[*] Fixed "gamebreaking" bug that prevented the final level from being unlocked if you quit to menu right after the Major Meteor fight. You could still unlock it by replaying the Major Meteor level and hitting "Next Level" instead of Return to Menu, and it would be unlocked perfectly fine and available if you've already beaten it, but it's insane to me that this bug has been in the game for 6 months and no one's reported it or anything. People are just hooked on Buff. GOTY every year.
[/list]

notes.title: LOOK AT ALL THIS COOL NEW STUFF WE'VE MADE FOR SUPER BUFF HD!
notes.content:
We get the distinct impression you folks really want to see more Super Buff HD, so here's an exclusive VIPs-only glimpse behind the Buffcorp beaded curtain to see what we've been working on lately...

[h3][b]BODYSURFING ON WALLS![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/717459c7664766559295554662aef49a5c864a4c.gif[/img]

Being able to surf on the flaccid, dead bodies of your enemies is just one of Super Buff HD's many unique USPs. [i]Kojima Subtitle voice[/i] (That's Unique Selling Point for anyone who's too cool to know that). Until recently, corpse-skating was limited to areas such as the floor and other unimaginatively horizontal surfaces. To remedy this limitation, Buffcorp has invented BODYSURFING ON WALLS. 

All the thrill of bodysurfing, but on a wall, which is a type of vertical floor. This will be a monumental step in dismantling the monopoly of the Big Floor™ corporations. Sic semper floorannis!

[h3][b]ATTACHABLE OBJECTS![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/46545cd8f69103abefe9c0e91156018d9393a547.png[/img]

Look at this guy. This is Bob. He sure does love his Moom. Keep at it, Bob! We're all proud of you! Wait a minute... Bob's not supposed to be wearing that helmet, is he? Hold on. Lemme check his ID...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/c861d6d35dd896c192539d0ffa1862ee17f55d51.png[/img]

Yeah! He's [i]not[/i] supposed to be wearing that helmet! Oh, but he'll be wearing that, and much more using our new ⭐ attachment system ⭐! Now any item can be attached to any enemy on any level! And of course you can shoot them off!

Now our resident [i]nerd lame-o supreme[/i] Cayden thinks it ought to be called a "cosmetics system." Which just put me into a 15-week long coma. While Omar, our resident [i]genius from the future[/i] thinks it should be called the "attaching things to things" system. Now doesn't that roll off the tongue much better? I think so too. And that's why we make the big bucks here.

[h3][b]FRESH BADDIES TO BOOP![/b][/h3]
The enemy design dept at Buffcorp has been working overtime on TWO new and crazy over-buffed baddies, the like of which have never been seen before in the world of gaming. First, here's a tank:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/11c1764865672723467f61bad2570379be2f1b6a.png[/img]

And this here's EEEEE (Elegantly Elevated Electronic Elite Englebort):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/add9ab35416e0a6f1ad8119a965db0275c699167.png[/img]

[h3][b]POPEFISH[/b][/h3]
This is Popefish. Not an enemy, just a bit of graffitti that can be found on Super Buff HD's walls/vertical floors. Our lead artist is open for commissions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/ce61e1172b37c505d5135af87084a369babce48a.png[/img]

[h3][b]BONUS GIFFERY![/b][/h3]
Here's a most sneakiest side-eye at a super secret work-in-progress stage. Check out EEEEE getting booped and blasting off. He was in such a rush he left behind his hat. And his gun nose. What a guy. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37540721/898bb86d5690ba7c02604c3928fd0d45ffaa169d.gif[/img]

This has been fun. We should do it again sometime. 

Your friends at Buffcorp x

[h3][b]WISHLIST & FOLLOW![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1295220/Super_Buff_HD/

PS. Our lead artist is not actually open for commissions. He's working on Super Buff HD, dummy.
